component.name: PaperPilot
component.summary: Privacy-first, local multi-surface PDF & document intelligence toolkit

description.p: PaperPilot is a fast, local-first document manipulation toolkit with over 90 operations. Designed with privacy by design: your files never leave your device.

ul.li: Merge, split, rotate, organize, and reorder PDF pages
Local OCR text extraction and scanned document searchability
Digital signatures, PIN encryption, and AcroForm processing
Integrated MCP server and HTTP microservice for local AI agent workflows

description.p: Release 0.6.0 with 91 tools, unmocked Tauri GUI test coverage, and offline-first intelligence.
